verdict.line: You lose if Blinding Dart shuts down your Hyper autos before level 6; you win if you reach Mega Gnar with Rage full and land R into a wall.

brief.thesis: This is a mirror poke matchup, not a dive matchup: Mini Gnar's Boomerang Throw actually outranges Teemo's 680-range auto and Blinding Dart, so pre-6 trading is about who lands the longer poke first. Teemo's Q Blinding Dart (8s cooldown) is the one tool that erases Gnar's W Hyper trading pattern by blinding his autos mid-fight. The whole lane funnels toward level 6, where OP.GG's own read and the 48.3% head-to-head over 145 games line up: Gnar's Rage bar filling into Mega Gnar and R is the actual win condition, not early poke damage.

theirWindow.what: Teemo can blind you mid-trade and free-hit with Toxic Shot autos while you can't land W Hyper's bonus damage. Hold your engage or boomerang throw until the blind is on cooldown, don't walk into auto range while it's up.

yourWindow.when: Rage bar maxed, you're Mega Gnar
yourWindow.what: Mega Gnar's R throws everyone around him in a chosen direction, stunning and adding bonus damage if they hit a wall. Force Teemo toward the lane wall or a brush edge before you pop it — that stun is your only hard kill condition on a champion this mobile and evasive.

powerCurve.note: Blind + poison poke outtrades pre-Q Gnar
Mini Q (1100 range) out-pokes his autos
Mega Gnar unlocks R, OP.GG's kill window
Noxious Trap zoning offsets your engage

start.why: Sustains the health potion poke race against Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot's damage-over-time; it's the higher-winrate start into this specific matchup (50% over 84 games vs 45.2% on Doran's Blade).

boots.why: Every point of Teemo's kit — Blinding Dart, Toxic Shot, Noxious Trap — is magic damage and the blind itself is a disable Tenacity reduces; this is the 79.1%-picked boot here for good reason.

core.why: Feeds the W Hyper on-hit damage and move speed spike that defines Gnar's poke trading before you're Mega.
Sustained armor shred for extended auto trades once you're forced into prolonged poke-offs rather than clean burst.
Highest-winrate finisher on this exact path (57.9% over 19 games) — the bonus health buys you through Teemo's chip damage long enough to reach R.

situational.when: the poison and blind poke is dragging out every trade and you need sustained attack speed and magic resist instead of burst
Noxious Trap and Toxic Shot's stacking magic DoT is outpacing your healing and sustain items
their jungler is adding to the gank pressure and you need flat tankiness over damage

runes.keystoneWhy: Fleet Footwork's heal-on-landed-attack and burst move speed lets you absorb Toxic Shot poke and reposition out of Blinding Dart range, which matters more here than raw damage since Teemo kites. Master-tier Gnar players instead run Lethal Tempo (56.5% over 1,803 games) — better suited if you plan to fully commit to auto-attack kiting fights rather than disengaging after each trade.

summoners.why: Flash + Teleport (65.1% pick) is the standard here for safely resetting after poke exchanges and getting back to lane after the inevitable back for sustain items. Flash + Ignite (25.9% pick) is the alternative when you want to convert your measured solo-kill advantage into an actual kill once Teemo is low from his own poke.

playing.title: Throw Mini Q at max range
playing.detail: Boomerang Throw reaches 1100 range and the boomerang can be caught to cut its cooldown — this outranges Teemo's 680-range auto and Blinding Dart, so poke from outside his threat range whenever the boomerang's up.

playing.title: Hold trades around Blinding Dart
playing.detail: Blinding Dart is only 8 seconds on cooldown and blinds your autos, directly countering W Hyper's bonus damage. Don't commit a full trade into a blind that's up — bait it out first.

playing.title: Bank Rage for level 6
playing.detail: Don't dump Rage into harmless pokes before 6. OP.GG's own read is to use R to kill Teemo after reaching level 6 — arrive at that level with a full bar so Mega Gnar's R is ready the moment you hit it.

playing.title: Land R into a wall, not open space
playing.detail: R only stuns and adds bonus damage to enemies that hit a wall — in open lane it's just a knockback and slow. Walk the fight toward the top lane wall or river brush before you commit the ultimate.

playing.title: Use mini E to punish stationary Teemo
playing.detail: Hop bounces off any unit it lands on for extra distance at only 475 range — use it to close the gap on a Teemo who's camouflaged and stood still, since movement breaks his invisibility.

playing.title: Don't let him go invisible unpunished
playing.detail: Camouflage triggers if Teemo stands still briefly, and leaving it grants him an attack speed buff. Keep pressure (wards, pokes, pushing the wave) so he can't reset into stealth for free value.

playing.title: Play around trap zoning near 16+
playing.detail: Noxious Trap has only a 1s cooldown late, letting Teemo lay zone-control mushrooms almost continuously. Scout brush and chokepoints before committing an all-in once he has rank-up R.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner picks above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning — why the blind matters, why R needs a wall, why Rage timing defines the fight — is this brief's own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: (Q) can be critical as you deal most of your damage through kiting basic attacks. Try to use [R] to kill him after reaching level 6.
